title: WIPEOUTVARIABLES DXF group-70 signed-width guard
scope: Prevent out-of-range DXF group-70 values from narrowing into aliases in DRW_WipeoutVariables::m_displayFrame while retaining signed-16-bit wire representations in the existing public unsigned carrier.

sources.title: Autodesk DXF group-code value types
sources.finding: Group-code range 60–79, including group 70, is a 16-bit integer value.

sources.title: Autodesk WIPEOUTVARIABLES DXF object
sources.finding: WIPEOUTVARIABLES group 70 is documented as 0 or 1. The related WIPEOUTFRAME system-variable mode 2 is retained on input but remains refused for strict DXF output pending a documented crosswalk.

implementation.behavior: DRW_WipeoutVariables::parseCode reads group 70 into a signed 32-bit temporary, rejects values outside INT16_MIN..INT16_MAX before changing the object, and stores the signed-16-bit bit pattern in the existing uint16_t field. Representable values outside the documented 0/1 DXF output domain remain available for diagnostics and are rejected by the strict writer guard from the preceding receipt.
limits: This guard establishes integer-width admission only; it does not establish the semantic meaning of values outside 0/1.
No public object layout or callback signature changed.

The ASCII DXF reader itself rejects some out-of-range numeric spellings before parseCode; the typed-parser guard covers values reaching the model parser. Both paths preserve the prior field value on rejection.

regressionControl.behavior: The focused wave1 selector covers signed-16-bit endpoints -32768 and 32767, representable values -1/0/1/2, and rejection of -32769/32768/65535/65536. Rejected records must leave the previous field value unchanged. The same selector also checks direct DXF writer acceptance only for group-70 values 0/1 and atomic refusal of 2/3/65535.
regressionControl.fixture: Generated ASCII group records in memory; no DWG/DXF fixture file is added.

validation.focusedTestResult: After the parser boundary correction, libdxfrw_wipeoutvariables_display_mode_domain passed 1/1 in 0.41 seconds. The adapter selector had passed 1/1 before the test-only boundary adjustment; the parser implementation was unchanged between those runs.
validation.diffCheck: git diff --check passed before receipt/plan edits; rerun after documentation changes
